lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: nice, not fancy fancy. the fun budget survived. best send-off anyone has ever had

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: a whole choice of dishes, and i picked mine all by myself :) maya, send us a postcard from the coast

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: six forks twirling, fresh plates all round, nobody doubled over, and cyrus off duty all night. organiser, signing off

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: the ONE job i gave myself. cyrus, i'm so sorry, there's peanut all over this menu

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: So I see. Consider me back on duty. We're leaving.

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i'm starving and even i'm walking out. that's how bad this is

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: wait. mina's been reading the same menu for ten minutes. there's nothing on it for her, is there

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: no, there isn't. meat or fish in every dish. i asked this time, so... can we go?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: she ASKED. the send-off is relocating. coats, everyone

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: i behaved, cyrus, i swear. but there was cheese snowed over everything and cream in whatever was left. my stomach is sitting out the toast

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: I said doubled over by dessert. You made it to dessert. That's progress.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: this is fancy fancy. a man refolded my napkin twice. the fun budget is filing a complaint

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i'll cover your dessert, maya. a send-off shouldn't come with more worries

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: a week of crackers and now everything comes out fried and golden, even the vegetables. so close

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: fruit stall on the boardwalk tomorrow, brooke. my treat :)

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i love this place. i still love it. but i've been twirling an imaginary fork all day and there's no pasta here

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: ok that one's on me, i said greek. liam gets pasta at maya's welcome-home dinner. it's in writing now
